nodes.name: webhook_reserva
nodes.notes: responseMode onReceived returns an immediate 200 to Meta before any processing (RNF-01): parsing, the three Sheets reads, evaluation and all writes run after the ack.

nodes.name: parse_reservation
nodes.notes: Parses body.entry[].changes[].value.messages[] -> { phone, query, quantity, rut }. Rules in order: quantity, RUT (removed from the medication query), leading intent keywords. Empty array on malformed payloads, never throws.

nodes.name: evaluate_reservation
nodes.notes: Fuzzy match (duplicated from US-04, drift-guarded by scripts/test-reserva.mjs) + RF-03 code + RF-04 stock validation + D-01 provisional initial state. Emits ONE item: { phone, decision, code, order_row, inventory_row, bitacora_row, expected_reservado, message }.

nodes.name: if_decision
nodes.notes: true = COMMIT (writes), false = REJECT (no write, message already final).

nodes.name: append_orden
nodes.notes: Write 1/4 (RF-03, D-01 provisional): appends the order row with codigo_far, estado and fecha_expiracion built by evaluate_reservation.

nodes.name: update_inventario
nodes.notes: CHOICE: operation 'appendOrUpdate' keyed on medicamento_id (tv4.5 exposes matchingColumns) instead of 'update' by row index, so a row insert cannot misroute the increment. OPEN RISK: parameter-level validation happens on first import (mappingMode/columns schema are not validated offline). stock_reservado is set to the expected absolute value; stock_neto is left alone because it is a formula column.

nodes.name: append_bitacora
nodes.notes: Write 3/4 (RF-04): audit trail accion = RESERVA_ALTA with delta_reservado = cantidad.

nodes.name: finalize_reply
nodes.notes: REJECT path forwards the pre-built message; COMMIT path re-reads inventario and flags CONFLICTO_INVENTARIO on mismatch (RNF-04). Emits { phone, message }.
